### Getting spans here
1. `make otel-up` (this stack) and open **Settings → Telemetry** in the TheYgent interface.
2. Set the OTLP endpoint to `http://127.0.0.1:4318/v1/traces`, enable export, and hit **Test connection** — the synthetic `otlp.test` span shows up below.
3. Run any agent; each run exports one trace whose spans nest exactly like the in-app run waterfall (same deterministic ids). Attributes you listed under *redact attrs* arrive as `[redacted]`; node I/O payloads never leave the machine at all.

panels.title: Recent traces
panels.description: TraceQL search results — click a trace ID to open the full span view.

panels.title: Traces with failed spans
panels.description: Any run containing a span whose node ended err — the exporter maps theygent's err status to OTel STATUS_ERROR, so this is the ‘what broke recently’ view.
